# The Peace Practice

> Compassionate clinical therapy, transformational coaching, and professional training with Ayana F. McKanney, LCSW. Licensed in New York, New Jersey, and Rhode Island with 26+ years of experience. All sessions are conducted virtually via a secure, HIPAA-compliant platform.

## Pages

- [Home](https://www.thepeacepractice.me/): Overview of clinical therapy, transformational coaching, and professional training
- [About](https://www.thepeacepractice.me/about): About Ayana Foluke McKanney, LCSW
- [Services](https://www.thepeacepractice.me/services): Clinical therapy, transformational coaching, and professional training & education
- [FAQ](https://www.thepeacepractice.me/faq): Frequently asked questions about therapy, coaching, licensing, and insurance
- [Contact](https://www.thepeacepractice.me/contact): Schedule a free consultation
